label: last two copy-phase steps (weak, token-modulated)
explanation: Fires mostly in the copy phase (86% of mass), concentrated on the final one or two output steps (to_go 0 holds 55% of mass, to_go 1 holds 22%). The secondary source is original step t=2 (about 12% of mass). It never fires at t=0, t=1, the delimiter, or recall_idx 0-1. Magnitude depends strongly on the input token: t, q, f and d give the highest rates and the top activations, for example L=3 sequences at the last step with input t/q/m/d. Even inside the predicted region it fires on only about 21% of steps, so precision is low. Token-gating raises F1 only slightly (0.39), which suggests a dense, distributed code rather than a clean feature.
